sentences.text:
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 90
Case :- Transfer Application (Criminal) No. - 470 of 2022
Applicant :- Akbar Ghazi And Another

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 6 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Noor Saba Begum,Sanjay Tiwari

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Shiv Prakash Gupta
Hon'ble Om Prakash Tripathi,J.

This transfer application has been moved by the applicants for transfer of Criminal Case No. 933 of 2022 arising out of Case Crime No. 280 of 2022 under Sections 498A, 336, 506 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P.
Act, Police Station Lisadi Gate, District Meerut.

entities.text: Police Station Lisadi Gate, District Meerut
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
The main submission is that application no. 2 is wife of opposite party no. 2 living in Muradnagar,
Ghaziabad.
It is submitted that opposite party no. 6 is an advocate in Civil Court, Meerut and creates hindrance and pressure in the case, applicant no. 2 feels inconvenience in attending court as witness.
Learned counsel for opposite party no. 2 submitted that entire family has been trapped in this case.

Husband, Jeth, Saas, Devar and Sasur have been roped in this case and one case crime no. 513 of 2020 under Sections 504, 506 I.P.C. and 3/4 Muslim Women (Protection on Divorce) Act 2019 Police Station Muradnagar, District Ghaziabad has also been lodged by the applicant no. 2 against opposite parties.

entities.text: Muslim Women (Protection on Divorce) Act 2019 Police Station Muradnagar, District Ghaziabad
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Distance between Muradnagar and Meerut is about 30 kms.

sentences.text: Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, it is not a fit case for transfer.
Ground for transfer of the aforesaid case is insufficient and therefore transfer application is hereby rejected.
Inform the court concerned through Sessions Judge Meerut.

Order Date :- 17.1.2023 Kalp Nath Singh  Akbar Ghazi And Another vs State Of U.P. And 6 Others on 17 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/63787288/
